runtime.name: vllm
runtime.source_revision_role: Official vLLM v0.28.0 release with Qwen3.5-family hybrid-model, NVFP4, and native MTP serving support.

composition.activation: opt-in; existing VLLM_SERVER_CONFIG remains compatible when no composition variable is set
composition.override_merge: objects merge recursively; scalar and array values replace

PREFER_MODELS.source: models key, model_slug, request_model_id, or alias

selection_rules: one model is allowed per vLLM process
a friendly model selection uses its primary catalog lane
switching models inherits a matching config from the selected hardware deployment when available

base_image.build_revision_note: Official CUDA 13.0 Ubuntu 24.04 vLLM image; PreFer adds only staging, inventory, and the warmup-aware gateway.

requirements.gpu_architecture: NVIDIA Blackwell; NVFP4 activation arithmetic requires SM100 or newer
requirements.nvfp4_backend: FlashInfer/CUTLASS on Blackwell; older GPUs use a weight-only fallback and are not a supported PreFer lane
requirements.driver_note: CUDA 13 images require an R580-or-newer host driver in normal mode; use the vLLM CUDA compatibility guidance for older supported drivers

hf.verification: exact catalog size and SHA-256 before atomic publication

features.structured_output: vLLM guided decoding; exact schema smoke required
features.streaming: gateway forwards backend SSE bytes and termination
features.kv_cache: FP8 KV is the performance default; calibration and long-context quality remain smoke gates
features.speculative_decoding: native Qwen3.5-family MTP head through vLLM speculative_config

qwen-3.8-flash.reason: Official recipe requires the dedicated qwen38-flash-next image and multi-GB300-class deployments; it is not part of this first 27B lane.

dflash2.reason: vLLM exposes DFlash2 for Qwen3.8 only in newer releases; do not replace the verified native MTP path without a matched artifact and smoke.

known_limitations: The checked-in deployment scenarios are configuration-only until an exact Blackwell card passes load, API, context, and throughput smoke.
Native MTP is first enabled at TP1; current qwen3_5_mtp TP>=2 loader issues are intentionally not hidden by a multi-GPU default.
The vLLM recipe verifies text serving; image and video input remain native capability metadata until the PreFer multimodal smoke passes.
A 32 GB Blackwell route may require enforce-eager and a smaller context because CUDA graph capture can OOM outside the model memory budget.
Model weights are runtime artifacts and never belong in this image or grouped release artifact.

qwen-3.8-27b.summary: A high-intelligence Qwen route for modern Blackwell GPUs, with native image/video capability metadata and a vLLM-verified NVFP4 text lane.
qwen-3.8-27b.architecture: 64-layer hybrid linear/full-attention vision-language model with 48 GDN layers, 16 full-attention layers, and one embedded MTP layer.
qwen-3.8-27b.context: Native 262,144 tokens; the provider-neutral lane starts at native context while larger Blackwell shapes expose separately gated extensions.
qwen-3.8-27b.reasoning: Thinking is enabled by default. Requests may select low, medium, or xhigh reasoning_effort and may disable or preserve thinking through the Qwen template controls.

limitations: FP8 KV remains a fidelity gate
multimodal vLLM path is not yet verified in this runtime
prompting_notes: Use xhigh for difficult tasks and low or medium for latency-sensitive work.
Preserve thinking only when the client needs it.
Use the Qwen3 coder tool schema for tool calls.

qwen-3.8-27b.evidence_confidence: high for upstream capability and artifact provenance; mixed for this repository's target-card fit and throughput until hardware smoke tests complete
